{{Top}}
An '''artisan''' was a skilled worker who could construct a variety of goods, including furniture, weapons, and supplies. Generally, the goods they could make were relatively basic, but artisans who honed their craft could specialize in more advanced fields, including [[Architect/Legends|architecture]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]], and [[Clothing/Legends|tailoring]]. They could also specialize in other more focused professions, such as [[armorsmith]], [[weaponsmith]], [[starshipwright]], [[Chef/Legends|chef]], or [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. Merchants, also known as traders, would often forgo the title artisan, and yet engage in very similar practices, crafting goods in several specific fields, such as munitions, structures, domestic goods, or [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]].

==Behind the scenes==
Artisan was one of the six basic starter [[W:c:swg:Profession|professions]] that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. However, the profession was removed during the [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] of [[November 15]], [[2005]] and rolled into one, all-encompassing [[W:c:swg:Trader|Trader]] profession. Prior to the NGE, players of the Artisan profession could gain experience to specialize in some of the more advanced crafting professions, such as [[W:c:swg:Armorsmith|Armorsmith]], [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith|Weaponsmith]], and [[W:c:swg:Chef|Chef]]. Following the NGE, these professions were also merged into the Trader profession to offer players a less complicated crafting system.

Despite being removed from the game as a playable profession, the term artisan was still used throughout the game to describe certain [[W:c:swg:Artisan assembly|assembly]] and [[W:c:swg:Artisan experimentation|experimentation skills]], as well as some [[W:c:swg:Artisan schematics|schematics]]. Players of the newly reformed Trader profession could also still grab missions from [[W:c:swg:Artisan Mission Terminal|Artisan Mission Terminals]].
